output_text: Lynn Davies, 58, from Neath, was given a suspended jail term of two years for unlicensed money lending, repaying £33,425 profit over seven years. He charged victims £500 on top of every £1,000 borrowed, and his crimes were exposed after an anonymous tip-off to the Wales Illegal Money Leading Unit. Davies threatened his victims and pleaded guilty to two counts of unlicensed money lending. The judge, Patrick Curran QC, emphasized the law's purpose in protecting the weak from exploitation.
